item.title: Hummus
item.description: I have opinions, some of them quite strong ones. And one opinion that I seem to not be able to change is that there is rubbish hummus in Germany. Every once in a while, a dear and well-intentioned friend 1 will approach me with this great hummu place they have discovered in XY-city that I should try. And so, I add it to my “To Try” map and once I am in the area, I will give it a try.
